subject: Renewal: Sequelis - Isolated analytics cluster + term & failover addendum
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@sequelis.com>
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@sequelis.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming renewal — isolation add-on scoping and timeline

Hi Alex,

Hope you had a good long weekend. With Sequelis's contract up for renewal at the end of Q2, I wanted to start the practical discussion around the requested isolated analytics footprint you flagged in last month's call. Based on our notes, you're looking for:

- A dedicated, on-prem analytics cluster (isolated VPC + edge nodes)
- Cross-region failover between primary site and DR in a nearby region
- 24-month term for reserved capacity (you previously queried longer term pricing)

Quick asks from our side to scope this accurately:
1) Desired target RPS / peak token throughput for analytics workloads
2) DR RTO target (minutes/hours)
3) Any procurement constraints (PO requirements, standard SOW language)

I can put a draft SOW and a term amendment together once we confirm those items. If it helps, we can do a 30-minute technical runbook session next week with our infra engineer (Karthik) to validate network/DNAT needs.

Are you available Thursday 10–11am PT for a quick sync?

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: none
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@sequelis.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@sequelis.com>, Procurement <procurement@sequelis.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — isolation add-on scoping and timeline

Thanks Sergio — Thursday works (10:30am PT would be better for our team). To answer your questions quickly:

- Peak throughput: analytics cluster will target ~1,200 concurrent sessions with bursts to 2,500 rps (token-heavy).
- DR RTO target: 2 hours maximum, failover automation preferred.
- Procurement: standard PO flow. We require the following on invoices: Sequelis Therapeutics, Attn: AP, PO# (we will provide once SOW finalized). Our legal team prefers 24-month term for reserved capacity but open to negotiating committed units.

Please loop in Karthik for the technical runbook. Also, can you attach a SOC2 summary and the latest SOW draft before the call? That will help expedite our Security review.

—Alex
Alex Kim
Principal Platform Engineer, Sequelis Therapeutics
alex.kim@sequelis.com | +1 (212) 444-8820
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@sequelis.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@sequelis.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-05T08:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — isolation add-on scoping and timeline

Alex, Julia — thanks. Call confirmed: Thu 2028-05-11 10:30am PT (calendar invite sent).

Attached: draft SOW (Sequelis_SOW_v2.pdf) and SOC2 executive summary (SOC2_Summary_2027.docx).

High-level proposal in the SOW:
- Provision a single isolated analytics cluster (8 x A100 equivalent nodes, dedicated VPC, KV-cache disabled for cross-tenant isolation)
- Standby DR cluster in us-west-2 with automated failover triggered by health-checks and manual playbook (RTO target 2 hours)
- Reserved capacity pricing is shown for 24 months; we included both 12-month and 24-month pricing lines in the pricing appendix for flexibility
- Term change: if you opt for 24 months, we can offer a 12% committed discount and a 6-month early-termination protection clause for migration windows

Notes / open items for the call:
- Network egress layout and public IP requirements (Karthik to walk through)
- PO and invoicing fields required by Sequelis AP (Monica, help capture any additional billing constraints)
- Approval path for the SOW (legal sign-off vs PO first)

Monica — are we able to hold the proposed pricing for two weeks pending PO submission if Sequelis confirms by 2028-05-18?

Regards,

Sergio
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Sequelis_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf), SOC2_Summary_2027.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@sequelis.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@sequelis.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — isolation add-on scoping and timeline

Thanks for the runbook session earlier — good alignment. A few items from pricing/ops: 

- We can hold the quoted 24-month reserved pricing through 2028-05-18 if Sequelis confirms intent to proceed and provides an initial PO number (paperwork to follow).
- Approval for the 12% committed discount requires a signed SOW + PO prior to provisioning; Finance needs the exact billing contact and a Ship-to address for the invoice (Sequelis billing details).
- If Sequelis prefers a 12-month contract with a shorter commit, we can offer a smaller 7% discount and a one-time migration credit (applied at invoice) to soften transition risk.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Sequelis to confirm preferred term (12 vs 24) and provide PO# placeholder by 2028-05-18.
2) We send final SOW and DocuSign package for signature (I will collect final billing fields).
3) Upon signed SOW + PO, ops schedules provisioning (target lead time 6 weeks).

Monica Patel
Senior Sales Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0133

Attachments: Invoice template stub (Invoice_PROV-890.xlsx)
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@sequelis.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@sequelis.com>, Procurement <procurement@sequelis.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — isolation add-on scoping and timeline

Monica / Sergio —

Thanks for the clarity. Sequelis will proceed with the 24-month committed term. Procurement will issue a placeholder PO (PO# SEQ-2028-1154) by EOD Friday. Please send the final SOW and DocuSign package to procurement@sequelis.com and cc me. Also attach the SOC2 summary in the DocuSign packet for our legal team.

One minor ask from AP: please include our EIN (12-3456789) and the invoice remit-to address in the final invoice fields so we can match records quickly.

We appreciate the hold on pricing through today — we’ll confirm the signed SOW within the week.

Best,

Alex
Principal Platform Engineer, Sequelis Therapeutics
alex.kim@sequelis.com
